sources.evidence: Separate senses for child/offspring, person, small particles, and nominal endings. Sense 9 includes 菓子, 冊子, 障子, 調子 and 帽子; ス refers to the same sense and includes 椅子, 扇子 and 様子. ス is identified as 唐音.
sources.limits: The kanji entry does not prove that every complete Japanese compound, modern sense or scientific coinage was directly borrowed from Chinese.

sources.evidence: Identifies 帽子 as kango and 子 as a suffix rather than literal child.
sources.limits: Do not turn its small-object gloss into an absolute size restriction.

decisions: Keep Chinese-derived nominal endings distinct from child/person uses and scientific particles.
A nominal ending may attach to an element already used as a noun; it need not supply literal child, small or a separately translated thing.
Keep the earlier audit's literal, scientific, ateji and whole-word-spelling cases unchanged.
Retain 柚 metadata while replacing the unqualified native-origin wording with explicit source attribution and the distinction between grouping and ultimate origin.
Keep evidence in contributor documentation, not the app archive. No new app schema or quiz categories.
